product.title: Horseshoe Bend and Antelope Canyon Adventure by Airplane

description.text: Fly from Grand Canyon Airport on a fixed-wing sightseeing plane that links the South Rim with Page-area landmarks. Aerial views of the canyon precede ground visits to Lower Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend with time at Lake Powell overlooks.

highlights: Fixed-wing airplane flight from Grand Canyon Airport
Ground tour of Lower Antelope Canyon slot formations
Visit Horseshoe Bend overlook above the Colorado River
Small-group format with narrated aerial commentary

start.description: Meet at Grand Canyon National Park Airport, 871 Liberator Dr, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023. Arrive 30 minutes before departure.

end.description: Return to Grand Canyon National Park Airport after the Page-area ground tour.

product.itinerarySummary: Fly from Grand Canyon Airport on a fixed-wing sightseeing plane that links the South Rim with Page-area landmarks.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon National Park
itineraryItems.description: Depart by airplane for aerial views of the South Rim and eastern canyon.

itineraryItems.title: Lower Antelope Canyon
itineraryItems.description: Walk through Lower Antelope Canyon with a Navajo guide among sandstone slot walls.

itineraryItems.title: Horseshoe Bend
itineraryItems.description: Stop at the Horseshoe Bend overlook for views of the Colorado River meander.

itineraryItems.title: Lake Powell
itineraryItems.description: Scenic viewpoints above Lake Powell on the return portion of the tour.

faqs.question: How long is the Horseshoe Bend and Antelope Canyon Adventure by Airplane?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 6 hours 30 minutes.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at the Grand Canyon?
faqs.answer: Meet at Grand Canyon National Park Airport, 871 Liberator Dr, Grand Canyon Village, AZ 86023. Arrive 30 minutes before departure.
